collection.description: A nursing mother is asked to help during a village emergency.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A nursing (mother.mother/father) caring for an infant is asked to help during a village emergency.

choices.label: Arrange trusted infant care and help briefly.
Stay with the baby while coordinating supplies.
Ask the village to share caregiving responsibilities.
